VMS Layout Tool

  1. Show your bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B).
  2. Drag this button onto the bar: VMS Layout Tool
  3. Log in to OMNIA, then click the bookmark. The editor opens on top of OMNIA and uses your existing session.

If your browser blocks bookmarklets, paste the script below into the developer console (F12) on the OMNIA page instead.

Rebuild after changing src/: node build.js
